## Summary

American pianist Eric Lu won the top prize at the prestigious International Chopin Piano Competition in Warsaw. The winner of the 19th edition of the competition receives a 60,000 euro ($69,972) prize and a gold medal funded by the President of Poland.

Lu, 27, is a graduate of the Curtis Institute. He won the Leeds International Piano Competition in 2018 and has performed with the Boston, London and Chicago symphony orchestras, among others. The second prize went to Canada's Kevin Chen, while China's Zitong Wang came in third.

## Summary of Results

Zitong Wang won third prize at the XIX International Chopin Piano Competition in 2025, and also received the Krystian Zimerman Award for the best performance of a Sonata. Wang performed in the final round with Andrzej Boreyko and the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra on Sunday, October 19, with competition prize winners announced on Monday, October 20.

Wang was born on February 3, 1999, in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China, and studied at the New England Conservatory under the guidance of celebrated pianist Dang Thai Son, himself a winner of the Chopin Competition. She previously won first prize in the Rosalyn Tureck Bach Competition in New York, as well as competitions in Princeton and Ferrol, Spain.
